<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude ja-JP terminology -->
In ja-JP UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → リモートコントロール. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP サーバー. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → デスクトップアプリ. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Session → セッション. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → チャット. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → サイドチャット
- Skill → Skills. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → Artifacts. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → 拡張機能. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → コンピューター操作. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → クイック入力. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → 開発者
- Model → モデル. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Turn → ターン. zh-Hans uses 轮: 轮到您了, 上一轮失败, 轮次失败.
- Folder → フォルダ. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → ワークスペース
- Repository → リポジトリ
- Worktree → ワークツリー. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → Git オリジン. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Sign in / Log in → サインイン. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → 組織 / 管理者
- Credentials → 認証情報
- Plan → プラン. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → 使用量（usage limits → 使用制限）
- Pin / Pinned → ピン留め. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → 信頼. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → 許可
- Approve / Approved → 承認
- this computer → コンピューター. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → スマートフォン
- Cloud → クラウド. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → 設定
- Configuration / Config → 設定. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → ウィンドウ
- Terminal → ターミナル
- Connect / Connected / Connection → 接続
- Restart → 再起動. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → 更新. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → デバッグ / ログ. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → 音声入力
